message.content:
The state machine transitions from NeedClientCert to NeedCertVerify upon receiving a Certificate message without ever validating the certificate (no chain verification, no check that it's acceptable). Similarly, CertificateVerify is accepted without verifying the signature against the certificate. An attacker can simply send Certificate → CertificateVerify → Finished messages to reach Established without any valid client authentication, bypassing the required TLS 1.3 client auth.

Answer: 9,10
